# Cairo Voyage (رحلة القاهرة)

> Private driver, private transfers and private tours in Egypt: Cairo, Giza, Alexandria and the North Coast (New Alamein, Marassi, Ras El Hekma, Marsa Matrouh), with transfers to any city in Egypt. Fixed price agreed before the trip. Booking on WhatsApp: +201201573544. Email: info@cairovoyage.com.

## Services
- Private driver by the hour or day (8 or 12 hours)
- Airport transfers: Cairo (CAI), Sphinx (SPX), Borg El Arab (HBE), El Alamein (DBB)
- Private sightseeing tours: Giza Pyramids, Grand Egyptian Museum, Islamic & Coptic Cairo, Alexandria, El Alamein, Fayoum
- City-to-city transfers across Egypt
- North Coast: car with driver by the day, chalet transfers, concert nights

## Fleet
- Sedan (Fiat Tipo), SUV (Jetour T2), family SUV (Geely Okavango), van (Hyundai H1)
